about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a full stack developer who enjoys the whole journey of a feature: understanding the business problem, designing the API, and shipping a polished interface. I've built ERP modules in Odoo, logistics APIs in Node.js, and customer-facing apps in Vue.js. I'm passionate about continuous learning and sharing knowledge to help teams deliver high-quality software.

contact.title: Let's work together
contact.body: I'm open to new opportunities and collaborations. The fastest way to reach me is by email.
